insights.summary: Voice agent transfers into Amazon Connect arrive with no order number or call reason; customer starts over.
insights.quote: When the voice agent transfers to a person in Amazon Connect, the agent sees nothing. No order number, no reason for the call. The customer has to start over.
CallRail reached out to our CMO directly. I'm not worried, but you should know they're circling.

insights.summary: PreSense shows agents which mattress the caller viewed; close rates on those calls are up.
insights.quote: PreSense has been the surprise of the year. Agents can see which mattress the person was looking at, and close rates on those calls are up.
